prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Persistent Account Pet Restore Reassurance Hint: Display a clear hint on the sign in screen explaining that signing into the correct account preserves and restores saved desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account to automatically preserve and sync all your desktop pets across sessions."}}
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Activity Mascot Tip Stream: Add an interactive tip carousel component to the waiting screen that shares tips on how to interact with the pet while rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls or chat!"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Controls Overview Screen: Insert a dedicated new screen after home welcome that visually explains desktop controls such as hiding, moving, and chatting with the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_overview"], "new_controls_overview": {"headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, and interact with your new pet right from your system tray.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Quick Guide", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Setup Diagnostics & Render Verification Flow: Add a progress status flow on the waiting screen with diagnostic status updates showing render completion and tray initialization.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Checking desktop display and graphics driver status...", "style": "highlight"}]}}
4: [finish, redesign] Interactive Tray Launch Checklist Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into an interactive checklist layout showing how the pet resides in the taskbar and system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Check off these quick setup steps to get familiar with your pet's desktop presence.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Locate pet icon in system tray", "style": "rounded"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Estimated Render Time Remaining Counter: Add an explicit estimated time remaining timer component on the waiting screen to set clear expectations while pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated rendering time remaining:", "style": "calm"}]}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] Split Path Stage Visual Showcase Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a stage layout with prominent path preview components highlighting pet adoption styles.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "body": "Select whether to adopt a classic pet or build a custom desktop companion.", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "large"}]}}}
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Generation Quality Assurance Hint: Add a reassurance hint on the photo upload screen explaining how photo selection affects the generated pet quality.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best generation results, upload clear, well-lit photos with your pet centered in the frame."}}
8: [sign_in, hint] Instant Sign-In Stalling Safety Hint: Add a troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen guiding users if the sign-in window is slow or blocked.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "If the sign-in window takes more than a few seconds to appear, click reload or check your browser permissions."}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Control & Visibility Reassurance Copy: Update headline and body on home_intro to clearly describe how to bring the pet back if hidden.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Pet!", "body": "Your pet is active on your screen. You can right-click its tray icon anytime to bring it to the front or customize behavior."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a clear sign-in reassurance hint without violating any rules.
Adds helpful interaction tips to the waiting screen.
Adds a new controls overview screen after home_intro while keeping all required onboarding steps.
Adds diagnostic render status progress to the waiting screen.
Redesigns home_intro to a taskbar checklist while preserving its welcoming function.
Timer on the waiting screen reflects a real wait and is permitted under rule 5.
Redesigns choose_path while retaining options for both adopting and creating a custom pet.
Adds a helpful quality tip to the photo upload screen.
Adds a helpful troubleshooting hint to the sign-in screen.
Updates home_intro copy with helpful guidance on pet visibility and tray controls.
